title: What Large Language Models Do Not Talk About: An Empirical Study of Moderation and Censorship Practices
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying hard and soft censorship (omission of information) regarding political figures across different languages and regions. While it uses normative frameworks like the UDHR and UNSDG as standards to identify omissions, its primary focus is on political discourse, content moderation, and geopolitical influence rather than religion, theology, or the benchmarking of moral/ethical reasoning systems.
